title: Foreign passport funds
subject: This guide addresses the regulation of foreign passport funds in Australia under the Asia Region Funds Passport framework. It covers entry requirements to become a notified foreign passport fund, ongoing obligations, and the denotification process.
background: The guide is issued under the Corporations (Passport) Rules 2018 (Australian Passport Rules) and the Corporations Act 2001 (Cth). It is intended for foreign passport fund operators seeking to enter or operating in Australia under the multilaterally agreed Asia Region Funds Passport framework.
ruling: ASIC explains its approach as host regulator for foreign passport funds, including assessment of notices of intention, ongoing compliance with AFS licensing and disclosure obligations, and discretionary powers to grant exemptions or modifications. The guide details entry requirements such as registration as a foreign company and compliance with the Australian Passport Rules. It also outlines ASIC's powers to remove notified funds (denotification) and enforce ongoing obligations like PDS disclosure, cooling-off rights, and advertising restrictions.
